addedText: The web demonstration may project a bounded set of at most three explicitly selected items, with every item satisfying the same source, identity, version, admission and ordinary Free-pool checks. Visitor choices reuse the existing track catalog and expose only available examples; the screen renders one selected item at a time. Changing its canonical track/item identity clears the preceding answer, feedback and expanded Details. A source-owned display projection may prepare authored Details paragraphs with the existing canonical formatting and source-link helpers, preserving their explanatory text and order without rendering schema metadata or source URLs as prose. This changes no canonical question or learning-session schema.
scope: BIZQ06 local bounded set, existing catalog selection, change/reset and source-owned Details display only; authorization/Premium/admission/release rules unchanged
